theorems.name: Submission.idtp_tdc_puvd_planar_piece_measure
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (V : Set (Euclid P)) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), 1 ≤ n → IsOpen V → BoundaryVanishes C → R.Represents C → Module.finrank ℝ Q = n → IsConnected (V ∩ (Q : Set (Euclid P))) → C.support ∩ V ⊆ (Q : Set (Euclid P)) → ∃ c : ℕ, ∀ E : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet E → E ⊆ V → R.measure E = (c : ℝ≥0∞) * μHE[n] (E ∩ (Q : Set (Euclid P)))
